{{Top|leg}}
'''D'larah starport''' was a small [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] in [[D'larah]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Demophon]], straddling the commercial and industrial sectors of the [[City/Legends|city]]. It hosted around fifty [[Hangar/Legends|docking bays]], half of which were reserved for the prototype [[Starship/Legends|starships]] produced by [[Shankti Drive Works]]. The rest were available for commercial and private traffic. [[Docking Bay 24]] was located at D'larah starport.
